## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to change)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Refactoring (no functional changes)
- [ ] Build/CI changes
- [ ] Performance improvement
- [ ] Security fix

## Checklist

- [ ] I have read the contributing guidelines
- [ ] I have run `bun run lint` and it passes
- [ ] I have run `bun run typecheck` and it passes
- [ ] I have run `bun run test` and all tests pass
- [ ] I have added or updated tests for my changes
- [ ] I have added or updated documentation for my changes
- [ ] I have added a changeset (for package releases)
- [ ] My changes follow the existing code style
